findings.summary: A future-dated acknowledgement is accepted during earlier reconciliation and can yield verified success from an observation preceding that acknowledgement.
findings.reproduction: Change only valid acknowledgement acknowledgedAt to NOW+1day; recompute exact raw pin. Reconcile at NOW+1second accepts it, calls observer at NOW and returns success. Other11 malformed acknowledgement cases refuse before observer.
findings.repair: Bound acknowledgement timestamp by current verification time and preserve acknowledgement-before-authoritative-observation chronology.
